nodes.description: Address of the contract owner, set to msg.sender in the constructor and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Payable marketing treasury address that receives a share of accumulated ETH fees.
Payable prize pool address that receives the remaining share of accumulated ETH fees.
Reflection (r-space) balance mapping per address.
Token (t-space) balance mapping declared but unused in transfer logic.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to allowance value.
Mapping marking addresses that are exempt from transfer fees.
Total reflection supply, decreased when fees are reflected.
Total token supply of 1e18 tokens.
Accumulated total of reflected token fees.
Reflection fee percentage (1), zeroed and restored around fee-exempt transfers.
Marketing fee percentage (7), also used in ETH distribution math.
Prize pool fee percentage (2), also used in ETH distribution math.
Immutable Uniswap V2 router used for the token to ETH swap.
Immutable Uniswap V2 pair address created in the constructor; used to detect buys/sells.
Reentrancy guard flag set by the lockTheSwap modifier around swapAndLiquify.
Public toggle controlling automatic swap-and-liquify on transfers.
Maximum wallet holding enforced for non-excluded recipients.
Contract token balance threshold above which a swap is triggered.
Caller-controlled address, used for ownership, fee exclusion and transfers.
Miner-influenced timestamp passed as the Uniswap swap deadline.
Initializes owner, marketing/prize addresses, supplies, Uniswap router and pair.
Public ERC20 transfer that routes through _transfer with msg.sender as sender.
Public approval that writes into _allowances through _approve.
Public transferFrom that spends allowance and routes through _transfer.
Increases an existing allowance using SafeMath.add.
Decreases an existing allowance using SafeMath.sub.
Owner-only function to force processing of the accumulated contract token balance.
Owner-only toggle for swapAndLiquifyEnabled.
Owner-only setter for the swap threshold.
Owner-only function that sets _owner to the zero address.
Private core transfer that optionally triggers swapAndLiquify before balances change.
Private swap routine, guarded by lockTheSwap, that swaps tokens and forwards ETH to marketing and prizePool.
Approves the router and calls swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with block.timestamp.
Applies or removes fees and enforces the max wallet holding check.
Executes r-space balance updates, operations fee taking and fee reflection.
Decreases _rTotal and increases _tFeeTotal to reflect fees to holders.
Credits the operations (marketing+prize) token share to the contract itself.
Address library helper that performs a low-level ETH call to a payable recipient.
Fallback receive function that accepts ETH from the Uniswap router.
Modifier that requires _owner to equal msg.sender.
Low-level recipient.call{value: amount}("") inside sendValue, an external call forwarding ETH.
marketing.sendValue and prizePool.sendValue ETH transfers performed at the end of swapAndLiquify.
External call to uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens.
The amount argument of the public transfer function.
The amount argument of the public transferFrom function.
The amount argument of the public approve function.
The boolean _enabled argument of setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled.
The _numTokens argument of setNumTokensToSwap.
Local balanceOf(address(this)) snapshot computed inside _transfer.
Local fee decision flag computed inside _transfer.
Local ETH share computed for marketing inside swapAndLiquify.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to _owner in the constructor, so the deployer controls owner privileges.
Constructor credits the entire reflection supply to msg.sender.
Constructor excludes msg.sender from fees based on the caller address.
The amount parameter is forwarded into transfer.
transfer invokes the private _transfer routine.
The amount parameter is used by transferFrom.
transferFrom invokes the private _transfer routine.
The amount parameter is written into _allowances by approve.
approve writes the spender allowance into _allowances.
increaseAllowance updates the _allowances mapping.
decreaseAllowance updates the _allowances mapping.
transferFrom reads the allowance before subtracting the spent amount.
_transfer performs an external swap and ETH payout before completing the balance updates of the current transfer.
_transfer delegates the actual token movement to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer invokes _transferStandard to move balances.
_transferStandard takes the operations fee share.
_transferStandard reflects the fee to holders.
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal through SafeMath.sub.
_reflectFee increases _tFeeTotal through SafeMath.add.
_takeOperations credits the contract address inside the _rOwned mapping.
swapAndLiquify first swaps accumulated tokens for ETH.
swapAndLiquify forwards ETH to marketing and prizePool after the swap.
The ETH distribution uses the Address sendValue helper which performs an external call.
sendValue executes a low-level call forwarding ETH to the recipient.
A malicious recipient of the low-level ETH call can re-enter the token transfer path.
The Uniswap swap calls back into the token pair, which can re-enter transfers while the swap guard is active.
A malicious marketing or prizePool address can re-enter swapAndLiquify during its ETH payout.
swapTokensForEth performs the external Uniswap router swap.
block.timestamp is supplied as the Uniswap swap deadline, making execution miner-influenced.
The stored uniswapV2Router is the target of the external swap call.
manualSwapAndLiquify lets the owner trigger the swap and ETH payout path directly.
manualSwapAndLiquify is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
The onlyOwner modifier compares the stored owner against msg.sender.
renounceOwnership writes the zero address into _owner.
renounceOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
The _enabled parameter drives the swapAndLiquifyEnabled write.
setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled writes the public swap toggle.
The _numTokens parameter drives the swap threshold write.
setNumTokensToSwap writes numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity.
The contract token balance local is computed inside _transfer.
_transfer compares the contract balance against the swap threshold.
_transfer checks swapAndLiquifyEnabled before swapping.
_transfer reads the inSwapAndLiquify guard before triggering a swap.
lockTheSwap toggles inSwapAndLiquify around the swap body.
_transfer compares from/to against uniswapV2Pair to classify buys and sells.
The takeFee local flag is computed and consumed inside _transfer.
_tokenTransfer enforces the _maxWalletHolding limit against the recipient balance.
_tokenTransfer zeroes __reflectFee when fees are not taken.
_tokenTransfer zeroes __marketingFee when fees are not taken.
_tokenTransfer zeroes __prizeFee when fees are not taken.
__marketingFee is multiplied by the new ETH balance to derive the marketing share.
__prizeFee participates in the denominator and remainder of the ETH split.
The contract ETH balance local feeds the fee split arithmetic in swapAndLiquify.
Constructor stores the Uniswap V2 router address.
Constructor creates and stores the Uniswap V2 pair address.
Constructor excludes the contract address itself from fees.
Constructor initializes the owner state variable with the deployer.
Empty receive function lets the contract hold the ETH returned by the Uniswap swap.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter exists only to feed the transfer entry point and should be folded into the transfer function node.
The amount parameter is only meaningful as input to transferFrom and should be merged into it.
The amount parameter is consumed solely by the approve function.
The _enabled parameter only feeds the swapAndLiquifyEnabled write inside this function.
The _numTokens parameter only feeds the threshold write inside this function.
The transient contract balance snapshot is used only within _transfer.
The takeFee flag is a transient local decision inside _transfer.
The marketing ETH share local is computed and consumed only in swapAndLiquify.
The contract ETH balance local is read and consumed only in swapAndLiquify.
